start: Download my data on a new phone with nothing logged, or on the sample member's data

steps.action: Tap 'Save the backup file' with nothing logged
user_sees: 'Nothing to back up yet. Log a workout or make a routine first.'

user_sees: 'This is the sample member's made-up data, so there is nothing of yours to back up.'
must_not: The demo data saved as the member's backup

user_sees: 'Your phone is short of space: this needs about N MB and only N MB is free. Free up some space, then try again. Nothing was changed.'

start: A backup was saved before today

steps.action: Tap 'Save the backup file' again
user_sees: A new file named with today's date; the older one in the app's own folder is replaced
must_not: Old backups piling up in the app's storage
The file already handed to Drive or Files deleted

steps.action: A photo is deleted while the save runs
user_sees: '... 1 photo could not be read and was left out.'
must_not: The whole save failing for one missing photo

steps.action: Open the share sheet and send the file
user_sees: The file holds only this member's own data
must_not: The phone number, gym membership, sign-in or another member's data in the file

steps.action: Look at photos in the file
user_sees: Progress photos are inside the file the member chose to make
must_not: The file sent anywhere by MettleUp itself; only the member's share-sheet choice moves it
